# Legacy-save fixtures

`version1.lvsave` was generated by the actual pre-development desktop game
using GCC/libstdc++, seed 20261011, before any simulation update.

`version1-libcxx.lvsave` was generated from commit 7eaa129 using Zig 0.13.0
targeting x86_64 Linux with libc++, with the same seed and zero updates.
The released ARM64 build uses the same Zig/libc++ runtime. This fixture checks
its original PRNG stream representation without claiming ARM device execution.

The development test chooses the fixture matching its standard library, checks
preserved villagers/time/PRNG, runs the upgraded village, and verifies version
2 save continuation. Cross-standard-library save exchange is not promised;
upgrading a KNULLI installation uses the same bundled C++ runtime as before.
